moments.author: Justus McNair
moments.quote: Game‑winner at the buzzer in double overtime to stun No. 24 Purdue 83‑80.
moments.why: A historic upset and one of college hoops’ most viral buzzer‑beaters in years.

moments.author: NBA
moments.quote: LUKA DROPS 53 PTS, now averaging over 40 PPG in 4 straight games.
moments.why: Luka Dončić is on a historic run already averaging over 40 points; viral among NBA fans.

moments.author: Ziaire Williams
moments.quote: “I’m the wrong white person” after confusing Dončić with Reaves.
moments.why: A hilarious locker‑room quip that immediately became a viral meme clip.

moments.author: SportsCenter
moments.quote: VALPARAISO TO WIN THE GAME AGAINST PURDUE AT THE BUZZER IN DOUBLE OT
moments.why: The dramatic clip of the Valpo buzzer‑beater spread like wildfire across sports fans.
